additional_info.body:
Hi Furkan,
I checked this charger and it's in failsafemode due to the EcoG LE.
Since this charger already has EcoG 1.4.11, there is not much we can do except test the Ethernet cable/Switch port.
If it doesn't work, then we need to replace the EcoG.
I recommend you to take a spare EcoG to site in case it needs replacement.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
